# Termicolor for Chrome & Edge

Browser frame, tab strip, toolbar and new tab page colors for Chromium browsers.

## Install

1. Open `chrome://extensions` (or `edge://extensions`) and enable **Developer mode**.
2. **Load unpacked** → select `dist/dark` or `dist/light`.

Chrome keeps one theme at a time; loading the other replaces it.

## Files

- [`dist/dark/manifest.json`](dist/dark/manifest.json)
- [`dist/light/manifest.json`](dist/light/manifest.json)
